1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Qc2 c5 5.dx.strategy: Almost forced: the d4 pawn is attacked and nothing guards it, so White takes. The pawn on c5 is exposed to the bishop, which means White will soon have to fight to keep it.

The main line: Black castles and waits to win the pawn back. Whether the bishop or a knight recaptures on c5 decides the character of the game, and White's next move decides which of the two is possible.

Gives up the bishop for the knight at once, to bring a knight to e4 after the recapture, where it attacks the queen and the c5 pawn together. It surrenders the bishop pair, and White keeps the extra pawn for the moment.
